meta.name: Meridian
meta.story: Meridian is bookkeeping for small studios — architects, designers, makers. It reconciles accounts, chases invoices and prepares taxes quietly in the background, so the work in front of you gets your full attention.
meta.audience: Independent studios of 2–30 people who care how their tools look and feel.

slots.headline: Money, in its right place.
slots.body: We take the noise out of running a studio — so the numbers stay true and the work stays first.

slots.title: Logomark
slots.body: The logomark is the symbol element of our logo, used independently of the wordmark where space is tight. Keep the clear space shown — half the mark's height on every side — and never redraw, outline or rotate it.

slots.title: Color palette
slots.body: Paper and Ink carry almost everything. Sky leads brand moments; Olive and Sage support. Ember is a signal — use it once per view, never as a background.

slots.title: Primary font
slots.body: PT Serif sets our headlines with a calm, bookish authority. Use it in promotional material, social and landing pages — not in the product UI.

slots.title: Secondary font
slots.body: DM Sans does the everyday work: interface, body copy, captions and tables. Friendly, legible, never loud.

slots.title: Brand imagery
slots.body: Imagery is soft and atmospheric — light over land and water, horizons rather than subjects. It should feel like the moment after the books are closed.

slots.title: Billboard
slots.body: At distance, the system reduces to one image, one line and the mark. Headlines stay in PT Serif; everything else gets out of the way.
slots.headline: Every invoice, gently chased.

slots.title: Product surfaces
slots.body: In the product, glass cards float on atmospheric color. Data uses Sky and Olive; Ember marks the one thing that needs attention.

slots.title: Street banner
slots.body: Banners lead with the headline and lockup on Paper, letting the architecture and sky do the rest.
slots.headline: Automate the books for every studio.

slots.title: Iconography
slots.body: Icons are drawn on a 24px grid with a 1.5px stroke and rounded joins. They inherit Ink and sit on soft white tiles.

slots.title: Usage
slots.body: A few rules keep Meridian recognisable everywhere it appears.
slots.do:
Lead with generous Paper and one strong image
Set headlines in PT Serif, sentence case
Use Ember for a single call to action
slots.dont:
Fill backgrounds with Ember
Stack more than two typefaces
Place text over busy image areas

items.text: Quiet confidence. Think gallery wall labels, not fintech dashboards.
Light over land and water — horizons, never subjects.
